title: Bandstop FIR Filter Design
text: Design bandstop FIR filter with tunable filter specifications, 5 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Window function} sets Window function; {Smooth tuned filter parameters}, {Smoothing factor}, {Specify filter order from input port} sets the flag to specify filter order from input, {Filter order (must be even)}, {Filter maximum order (must be even)} sets the maximum order of filter, {Specify center frequency from input port} sets the flag to specify center frequency from input, {Center frequency}, {Specify bandwidth from input port} sets the flag to specify bandwidth from input port, {Bandwidth} sets the filter bandwidth, {Specify sidelobe attenuation from input port} sets the flag to specify sidelobe attenuation from input, {Sidelobe attenuation (dB)} sets the sidelobe attenuation in dB, {Specify kaiser window parameter from input port} sets the flag to specify Kaiser window parameter from input, {Kaiser window parameter}, {Sample time (−1 for inherited)} sets the sample time in seconds, {Output data type} sets the data type of filter and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
